text:
Jordan (sales_eng): Hey team, AcmeBank is asking if we can run a 2-week air-gapped POC on their isolated DC. Requirements: signed offline bundle, SBOM, HSM-backed key for license activation, and a staged delta update process. Timeline: start next Monday. Can we deliver?
Marta (account_exec): Thanks Jordan. Two questions up front: 1) any extra fees for offline bundle packaging/signing? 2) SLA for POC support (on-call hours)?
Sam (infra): Short answer: yes, it's doable. We have two delivery options: full-install tarball (~8–12GB depending on model artifacts) or a split: bootstrap + model chunks. For airgap I recommend split bundles to avoid huge single files.
Sam (infra): We can provide signed bundles if they give us a public key (we sign with their keypair) or we can sign and ship our signed artifact plus an attest file. We also emit an SBOM and CVE list.
Priya (security_engineer): HSM requirement: do they need license keys stored in their HSM, or do they just need KMS/HSM integration for encryption at rest? If they need HSM-based signing of activation tokens we need their HSM access during provisioning or an offline workflow for token signing.
Jordan (sales_eng): They said "HSM-backed license" and "customers must control private keys". Sounds like they want key custody.
Priya (security_engineer): OK that means we ship unsigned artifacts and provide the signing workflow. We can provide a small `signing-helper` container with a documented set of commands and an offline CSR flow. Example command: `sha256sum redwood-offline-1.4.0.tar.gz` and then `./signing-helper sign --input ... --output signature.sig`
Marta (account_exec): Can we include this as part of standard POC (no extra charge) or bill it as professional services? Also legal asked if we can commit to a 30-day patch window for critical fixes during the POC.
Sam (infra): For POC we can include basic packaging & docs free. Anything that requires our engineers on-site or a bespoke signing integration should be PS. Remote signing workflow + docs = free. On patch cadence: we can do critical security patches within 7 calendar days (remote patch instructions + signed delta bundle). Non-critical patches follow quarterly cadence.
Jordan (sales_eng): Good. What about delta updates — can we do small patches instead of full reinstall?
Sam (infra): Yes — we support chunked deltas. The offline bundle format supports delta manifests. Workflow: customer runs `redwood-updater apply --manifest delta-2026-03.json --signature sig` on the jumpbox. We supply the manifest and signed chunks. Note: deltas require the same model quantization/variant to avoid compatibility issues.
Priya (security_engineer): For compliance, we need to provide: SBOM, signature verification steps, reproducible build notes, and a list of required firewall egress IPs (for optional telemetry). Also need confirmation we do not phone home by default.
Sam (infra): We will default to no phoning home. Telemetry can be enabled with explicit consent and documented outbound IPs. SBOM + verification docs included.
OpsBot (deploy-bot): NOTE: created ticket INF-1242 for airgap packaging. Assigned: Sam. ETA: 5d for initial artifact + docs.
Marta (account_exec): Legal also wants to know licensing model for offline POC: is it trial (no charge) or time-limited entitlements? They want a written statement for procurement.
Jordan (sales_eng): We usually do time-limited entitlements (30-day dev license) and then convert to either usage billing or reserved capacity if they move to Dedicated. Can we draft a short entitlements statement?
Sam (infra): I'll draft a one-paragraph entitlements note: 30-day dev entitlement for POC, limited to N nodes, no production SLA, patches limited to critical security updates during POC unless PS engaged.
Priya (security_engineer): Also add data handling: no customer data leaves the network in default mode. If they enable telemetry, we send only anonymized health metrics.
Marta (account_exec): Perfect. Final ask: can we commit to a single offline upgrade window (2–4 hours) for the cutover? Customer expects a short maintenance window.
Sam (infra): Plan for staged cutover: jumpbox apply + service restart. Typical window 30–90 minutes for deltas, up to 2–4 hours for full model swap depending on model size. We'll document exact steps and rollback commands (`systemctl restart redwood && journalctl -u redwood -n 200`).
Jordan (sales_eng): Great — next actions: 1) Sam produce artifact + docs (INF-1242), 2) Priya prepare security checklist & signing workflow, 3) Marta prepare entitlements statement & pricing note for procurement. Start Monday.
Marta (account_exec): I'll loop in procurement and legal. Tagging @AcmeBank-PoC contact in the email thread today. :thumbsup:
Jordan (sales_eng): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me in thread.
Sam (infra): I'll post the initial artifact link in this channel once INF-1242 has a build.
Priya (security_engineer): One more note — if customer requires FIPS/HSM attestation we need 2 extra weeks for validation. Flagging in case procurement asks.
Marta (account_exec): Noted. I'll surface that as a potential timeline extension.
Jordan (sales_eng): Closing for now, will update after artifacts are available.
